statement: The real realization maxima are determined for all seven-vertex Laman graphs. The graphs L136 and L344 attain all 136 and 344 complex realizations over the reals, respectively, and L880 admits at least 860 real realizations.

answer.text: Completes the seven-vertex classification and gives certified total reality for L136 and L344; L880 has at least 860 real realizations.

The §4.1 computations complete the seven-vertex Laman real-count classification. The displayed larger examples attain all 136 and 344 complex realizations over the reals for the eight- and nine-vertex graphs L136 and L344, respectively; for L880 the verified lower bound is 860, not the 868 suggested by floating-point output. The final counts were checked with Maple RootFinding[Isolate].
scope: Seven-vertex Laman graphs and the specific eight-, nine-, ten-vertex graphs L136,L344,L880 of Figure 9; real edge labels; modulo translations and rotations.
